svg.title: Connect FigTether to Figma
svg.desc: Run figtether start from the source checkout. It builds the plugin, prepares the manifest, starts the daemon and prints a one-time pairing secret. Import the printed dist/manifest.json in Figma, open Bridge and pair. Share selected frames, enable Allow editing if desired, and review plans or explicitly enable eligible Auto mode. A fresh secret is available with figtether pair; it lasts five minutes and works once.
svg.text: FIGTETHER / GET CONNECTED
From terminal to canvas.
Start once. Pair the plugin. Choose what to share.
Start on your computer.
Run this from the source checkout:
figtether start
Builds the plugin and starts the daemon.
Keep the terminal open for its pairing secret.
Open the plugin in Figma.
Import the printed dist/manifest.json.
Open Bridge, paste the secret, then Pair.
Share a frame.
Select a frame, then Update selection.
Choose the frames and share them in Bridge.
Choose how editing works.
Enable Allow editing when you want changes.
Review plans, or explicitly turn on Auto.
Already running? Need a fresh secret?
figtether pair
The secret works once and expires after 5 minutes.
Pairing connects; sharing grants design access.
Keep the secret out of chat and MCP configuration.
